claim_ceiling: reusable descriptive and validation dimensions; not an exhaustive decomposition of language or cognition

dimensions.definition: How discourse selects what it is about, assigns grammatical subjecthood and marks contrastive or new information.
pointfire_risks: L1 adds a claimant or actor
L3 changes premise or conclusion prominence
authored_examples: 这件事，我还没有结论。 / I have not reached a conclusion about this matter.
counterexamples_and_variation: Mandarin also has ordinary subject-predicate clauses.
English permits topicalization and clefts.
Genre and discourse context change preferred ordering.

dimensions.definition: How agents, patients, causes and responsibility are overtly expressed, backgrounded or omitted.
pointfire_risks: L4 invents or erases causal responsibility
authored_examples: 杯子碎了 does not license 他摔碎了杯子 without evidence.
counterexamples_and_variation: Agent mention changes with task and context.
Within-language voice choices are diverse.
Experimental group effects do not define national responsibility norms.

dimensions.label_zh: 时制、体貌、事件轮廓与终点
dimensions.definition: How temporal location, ongoingness, completion, boundedness and endpoint attainment are encoded.
pointfire_risks: L2 changes process into bounded event
L5 validates against wrong time window
authored_examples: 他在写报告 is not equivalent to He wrote the report.
counterexamples_and_variation: Lexicon and context can express time without morphological tense.
An aspect marker does not have one fixed cross-language equivalent.
Nonlinguistic endpoint judgments may remain similar.

dimensions.label_zh: 证据来源、情态与确定性
dimensions.definition: How direct evidence, report, inference, possibility, obligation and certainty are marked.
authored_examples: 据说他走了 cannot silently become He has left.
counterexamples_and_variation: Languages without obligatory evidential morphology still mark sources lexically.
Evidential morphology does not guarantee truth.
Turkish -miş has context-sensitive functions.

dimensions.label_zh: 省略、可恢复性与指称链
dimensions.definition: Which participants may be omitted, how they are recovered and how reference persists across clauses.
pointfire_risks: L1 adds or loses a participant
L3 carries inference across the wrong entity
authored_examples: 问过了，说还要等 requires context before assigning who asked and who spoke.
counterexamples_and_variation: English also omits material in imperatives, dialogue and coordination.
Mandarin repeats nouns when ambiguity is high.
Recoverability depends on discourse and viewpoint.

dimensions.label_zh: 分句连接、意合与显性连词
dimensions.definition: How temporal, causal, contrastive and concessive relations are built by juxtaposition, subordination or connectives.
authored_examples: 天黑了，他还没回来 does not by itself license Because it was dark, he had not returned.
counterexamples_and_variation: Mandarin academic prose can be highly explicit.
English literary prose can use parataxis.
Context may strongly license an unspoken relation.

dimensions.label_zh: 事件词汇化：方式、路径、原因与结果
dimensions.definition: How verbs and associated structures foreground manner, path, cause and result.
pointfire_risks: L4 moves the intervention or result boundary
authored_examples: 他跑进屋 encodes manner and path; He entered omits manner unless recorded as residue.
counterexamples_and_variation: Every language has multiple constructions.
Verb availability and genre alter choices.
Different descriptions can coexist with similar nonlinguistic categorization.

dimensions.label_zh: 信息顺序、给定／新信息与预设
dimensions.definition: How background, shared information, new assertions, contrast and conclusions are ordered or presupposed.
authored_examples: 鹤从宫门上空飞过。人们后来怎样解释，是另一回事。
counterexamples_and_variation: News, scholarship, conversation and fiction use different orders.
Rhetorical inversion may be purposeful.
Given-new mapping is context dependent.

dimensions.label_zh: 社会视角、礼貌、敬语与立场
dimensions.definition: How participant relationships, deference, distance, viewpoint and stance enter linguistic form.
authored_examples: An honorific choice can encode relation without proving sincere approval of authority.
counterexamples_and_variation: Honorifics may be polite, professional, ironic or strategic.
Usage varies by setting and speaker.
No form reveals a whole social attitude.

dimensions.definition: How available lexical and constructional resources distinguish categories and levels of abstraction.
authored_examples: When no one-word equivalent exists, use an explanatory phrase and preserve residue.
counterexamples_and_variation: Borrowing and paraphrase expand expression.
Professional vocabularies differ within a language.
A lexical gap does not make a concept unthinkable.

dimensions.definition: How pauses, prominence, sentence length and punctuation distribute processing load and emphasis.
authored_examples: A long sentence may preserve a reflective turn; a short sentence may merely interrupt it.
counterexamples_and_variation: Reading medium and author voice matter.
Punctuation statistics cannot establish literary quality.
Long and short forms can both be idiomatic.

dimensions.label_zh: 语体、文类与文学标记性
dimensions.definition: How formal, informal, spoken, written, historical, professional and deliberately marked forms are selected.
authored_examples: Marked syntax may remain when its viewpoint or rhythmic gain is explicit and claims are unchanged.
counterexamples_and_variation: Authors move across registers.
Literary lineages are not grammar rules.
Unusual form can be deliberate or simply unformed.
